name: Dropbox's original YC application
summary: Dropbox's original YC application in full: solo founder Drew Houston's answers on company, founders, progress, idea, equity and legal.
description: The full text of Dropbox's original Y Combinator application: the company and its demo links (a screencast and a Windows build), the founding team and Drew Houston's answers across company, founders, progress, idea, equity, legal and other sections. Houston applies as a single founder and writes that he is looking for a cofounder.
